title: Baby Chewing Snack in High Chair, 1968 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot captures a sweet candid moment of an infant sitting in a vintage high chair with a floral-patterned tray, chewing on a snack or teether. The background features decorative faux-tile wallpaper typical of mid-century American home kitchens. Inscribed with the date 'June 68' on the back, the image provides an authentic glimpse into everyday domestic family life during the late 1960s.
